The '''Weneen sector''' was in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Kurluvion system/Legends|Kurluvion]] and [[G'wenee system/Legends|G'wenee systems]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] known as the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]] passed through this sector.<ref name="TEA" />
